reason: Trace status/failure data from backend to UI.

findings.summary: GET /applications/{id}/artifacts returned a bare array while the frontend expected {items}; backend now returns ReadinessArtifactListOut and API tests assert the envelope.

FailurePanel was gated on application status failed; readiness failures can persist latest_error without changing status, so the panel now appears whenever latest_error contains a valid failure envelope.
Fast Refresh lint warning removed by moving artifact type labels into the shared status module.

commands.cmd: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m compileall app/api/v1/applications.py app/schemas/readiness.py app/tests/test_applications_api.py

commands.note: Vite reported an existing large chunk warning only.

commands.cmd: cd backend && APP_ENV=test MODEL_PROVIDER=fake DATABASE_URL='postgresql+psycopg://app:app@localhost:5432/job_search_agent_test' .venv/bin/pytest -q app/tests/test_applications_api.py app/tests/test_readiness_artifacts.py

notes: An initial parallel pytest run against the same shared PostgreSQL test database failed from test-environment interference (table truncation, missing relation, duplicate keys). The same target and full suites passed when rerun serially.
